meta.description: Half-court calibration template for the 500x940 PORTRAIT top-down canvas. Copy this file to court_calibration.json, then replace every image_points value with the clicked [x, y] pixel location in a frame from your video. Leave court_points untouched.
usage: 2. grab one frame from the video (any frame; the camera is fixed)
3. click each named landmark and write its pixel [x, y] into image_points
4. at least 4 points are required; more points and a wider spread give a better fit
5. delete any landmark you cannot see in frame from BOTH image_points and court_points
meta.warning: The -1 placeholders below are not valid calibration. load_court_calibration will happily accept them and produce a meaningless homography, so every point you keep must be replaced with a real click.
meta.court_points_note: court_points are pixel coordinates on the 500x940 portrait canvas and are derived from FIBA 3x3 half-court geometry. Do not edit them unless you also change canvas/render.court in configs/default.yaml.
